rationale: Plan-v2 Step 1 quantitative gate. Present queries are visible in the scene (two seated people, monitors, chairs, desk, keyboards); absent queries are unambiguously not in an office scene. Used as a regression check for the v5 panoptic pipeline before changing anything in BA (Steps 2 / 3).

hit_rate_present.operationalised_as: top-1 raw cosine >= cos_floor (default 0.04 in scripts/query_panoptic.py)

fp_rate_absent.operationalised_as: top-1 raw cosine <  cos_floor (i.e. no track passes the floor)

note: Re-tune cos_floor at Step 4 (v7) when switching to siglip-large-patch16-384; this gate is for the v5 baseline.
